purpose: rank the proteins of a phage genome by probability of being a holin
recipe: HistGradientBoosting over 36 handcrafted features + 480-d mean-pooled ESM-2 (t12_35M). TM-anchored local features were tested and rejected (scripts/15).

honest_performance_leave_one_genome_out.note: this model is used only AVERAGED with holin_model_curated.pkl (predictor --holin-mode t4aware). Leave-one-genome-out on 78 CPT genomes, novel family, for that average (scripts/50, reports/holin_generalisation.md): ranked 1st 0.513 vs 0.538 for the standard model (-0.026 [-0.064, 0.000]), top 5 0.846 vs 0.846, T4-type holins ranked 3-30 vs 10-67; experimental set 6/8 vs 7/8 ranked 1st.

known_limits: about one mined positive in five is not a holin (rule precision 76-82% on CPT)
not better than the standard model overall; use it for T4-like phages
usage: import pickle, features as F; m=pickle.load(open('models/holin_model_curated.pkl','rb')); X=hstack([handcrafted, esm.embed(seqs)]); m['model'].predict_proba(X)[:,1]
